references.phrase: simple undirected graphs G and H

references.context: Function injective and surjective on the entire target vertex set.
For every distinct u,v, edge {u,v} occurs in G exactly when {f(u),f(v)} occurs in H.
Edges are two-element subsets, without orientation or loops.

references.disposition: Preservation alone is insufficient; reflection and bijectivity are required.

review_rationale: Reviewed graph isomorphism as bijective vertex map preserving and reflecting unordered adjacency, assuming both graph inputs simple and undirected and distinct-vertex condition.
